controles.affirmation: Accord de non-poursuite avec le DOJ en mai 2025 (244 M$ d'amende, 445 M$ d'indemnisation des familles), approuve par le tribunal en novembre 2025, appel toujours pendant devant la Cour d'appel du 5e circuit.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 Note 23 : "On May 29, 2025, Boeing and the Department of Justice (the Department) entered into a non-prosecution agreement... The Agreement requires, among other things, Boeing to pay a fine of $244 and provide $445 of additional compensation for the family members... On November 6, 2025, the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas (the Court) approved the Motion; however, representatives of family members appealed the Court's decision, which appeal is pending before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit."

controles.affirmation: Recours boursiers encore pendants lies au 737 MAX et a l'incident de la porte du 737-9 de janvier 2024.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 Note 23 : "securities lawsuits are pending, including a motion for class certification on a federal securities class action before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois. Multiple investigations and legal actions, including securities lawsuits, were also initiated as a result of the January 2024 737-9 door plug accident."
